verses.en: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
verses.pt: Sobre a minha torre de vigia me colocarei e sobre a fortaleza me apresentarei e vigiarei, para ver o que me dira, e o que eu responderei no tocante, a minha queixa.
verses.en_web: I will stand at my watch, and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
verses.en_bbe: I will take my position and be on watch, placing myself on my tower, looking out to see what he will say to me, and what answer he will give to my protest.

verses.en: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.pt: Entao o Senhor me respondeu , e disse: Escreve a visão e torna-se bem legivel sobre tabuas, para que a possa ler quem passa correndo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord gave me an answer, and said, Put the vision in writing and make it clear on stones, so that the reader may go quickly.

verses.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
verses.pt: Pois a visão é ainda para o tempo determinado, e se apressapara o fim. Ainda que se demore, espera-o; porque certamente virá, não tardará.
verses.en_web: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it; because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
verses.en_bbe: For the vision is still for the fixed time, and it is moving quickly to the end, and it will not be false: even if it is slow in coming, go on waiting for it; because it will certainly come, it will not be kept back.

verses.en: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
verses.pt: Eis o soberbo! A sua alma não é reta nele; mas o justo pela sua fé viverá.
verses.en_web: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
verses.en_bbe: As for the man of pride, my soul has no pleasure in him; but the upright man will have life through his good faith.

verses.en: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
verses.pt: Além disso, o vinho é traidor; o homem soberbo não permanece. Ele alarga como o Seol o seu desejo; como a morte, nunca se pode fartar, mas ajunta a si todas as nações, e congrega a si todos os povos.
verses.en_web: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. A haughty man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol, and he is like death, and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations, and heaps to himself all peoples.
verses.en_bbe: A curse on the cruel and false one! the man full of pride, who never has enough; who makes his desires wide as the underworld! he is like death; he is never full, but he makes all nations come to him, getting all peoples together to himself.

verses.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
verses.pt: Não levantarão, pois, todos estes contra ele um provérbio e um dito zombador? E dirão: Ai daquele que acumula o que não é seu! (até quando?) e daquele que se carrega a si mesmo de penhores!
verses.en_web: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’
verses.en_bbe: Will not all these take up a word of shame against him and a bitter saying against him, and say, A curse on him who goes on taking what is not his and is weighted down with the property of debtors!

verses.en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
verses.pt: Não se levantarão de repente os teus credores? e não despertarão os que te farão tremer? Então lhes servirás tu de despojo.
verses.en_web: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
verses.en_bbe: Will not your creditors suddenly be moved against you, and your troublers get up from their sleep, and you will be to them like goods taken in war?

verses.en: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.pt: Visto como despojaste muitas nações, os demais povos te despojarão a ti, por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violência para com á terra, a cidade, e todos os que nela habitam.
verses.en_web: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you, because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.
verses.en_bbe: Because you have taken their goods from great nations, all the rest of the peoples will take your goods from you; because of men's blood and violent acts against the land and the town and all who are living in it.

verses.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
verses.pt: Ai daquele que adquire para a sua casa lucros criminosos, para pôr o seu ninho no alto, a fim de se livrar das garras da calamidade!
verses.en_web: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
verses.en_bbe: A curse on him who gets evil profits for his family, so that he may put his resting-place on high and be safe from the hand of the wrongdoer!

verses.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
verses.pt: Vergonha maquinaste para a tua casa; destruindo tu a muitos povos, pecaste contra a tua alma.
verses.en_web: You have devised shame to your house, by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.
verses.en_bbe: You have been a cause of shame to your house by cutting off a number of peoples, and sinning against your soul.

verses.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.pt: pois a pedra clamará da parede, e a trave lhe responderá do madeiramento.
verses.en_web: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.
verses.en_bbe: For the stone will give a cry out of the wall, and it will be answered by the board out of the woodwork.

verses.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.pt: Ai daquele que edifica a cidade com sángue, e que funda a cidade com iniqüidade!
verses.en_web: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!
verses.en_bbe: A curse on him who is building a place with blood, and basing a town on evil-doing!

verses.en: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
verses.pt: Acaso não procede do Senhor dos exércitos que os povos trabalhem para o fogo e as nações se cansem em vão?
verses.en_web: Behold, isn’t it of Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
verses.en_bbe: See, is it not the pleasure of the Lord of armies that the peoples are working for the fire and using themselves up for nothing?

verses.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.pt: Pois a terra se encherá do conhecimento da glória do Senhor, como as águas cobrem o mar.
verses.en_web: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.en_bbe: For the earth will be full of the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the sea is covered by the waters.

verses.en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
verses.pt: Ai daquele que da de beber ao seu próximo, adicionando à bebida o seu furor, e que o embebeda para ver a sua nudez!
verses.en_web: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!
verses.en_bbe: A curse on him who gives his neighbour the wine of his wrath, making him overcome with strong drink from the cup of his passion, so that you may be a witness of their shame!

verses.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’S right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
verses.pt: Serás farto de ignomínia em lugar de honra; bebe tu também, e sê como um incurcunciso; o cálice da mão direita do Senhor se chegará a ti, e ignomínia cairá sobre a tua glória.
verses.en_web: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink, and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
verses.en_bbe: You are full of shame in place of glory: take your part in the drinking, and let your shame be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's right hand will come round to you and your glory will be covered with shame.

verses.en: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.pt: Pois a violência cometida contra o Libano te cobrirá, e bem assim a destruição das feras te amedrontrará por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violência para com a terra, a cidade e todos os que nele habitam.
verses.en_web: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals, which made them afraid; because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.
verses.en_bbe: For the violent acts against Lebanon will come on you, and the destruction of the cattle will be a cause of fear to you, because of men's blood and the violent acts against the land and the town and all who are living in it.

verses.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
verses.pt: Que aproveita a imagem esculplda, tendo-a esculpido o seu artífice? a imagem de fundição, que ensina a mentira? Pois o artífice confia na sua própria obra, quando forma ídolos mudos.
verses.en_web: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?
verses.en_bbe: What profit is the pictured image to its maker? and as for the metal image, the false teacher, why does its maker put his faith in it, making false gods without a voice?

verses.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.pt: Ai daquele que diz ao pau: Acorda; e à pedra muda: Desperta! Pode isso ensinar? Eis que está coberto de ouro e de prata, e dentro dele não há espírito algum.
verses.en_web: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.
verses.en_bbe: A curse on him who says to the wood, Awake! to the unbreathing stone, Up! let it be a teacher! See, it is plated with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all inside it.

verses.en: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
verses.pt: Mas o Senhor está no seu santo templo; cale-se diante dele toda a terra; cale-se diante dele toda a terra.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord is in his holy Temple: let all the earth be quiet before him.
